records.subject: Getting started with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

records.text: :tada: New signup: *Summit Ventures* just joined on the starter plan!

decisions.rationale: Onboarding call held as scheduled [calendar:aa7dd752] is a positive engagement signal, but 3 days later there is still no project, no invite, no milestone, and Sofia never replied to either outreach [email:6296c857, email:296eabab]. Starter plan, 6 days old, 8 days left; no tickets suggests low urgency.

draft.subject: Following up after our onboarding call
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for making time for the onboarding call last week. I know the week after a call is usually when things get busy, so I wanted to check in.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring the team in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that came up afterwards.

Best,
Nadia
